response.justification: Strong hands-on engineering depth (15+ years) with genuinely relevant developer-tooling credentials — authored a D test runner and assertion library, built CI/CD and device-orchestration infrastructure, ran testing/Selenium courses, and currently works on developer tooling and MCP code generators. However, the role is fundamentally a people-management position, and the resume shows no evidence of managing engineers, running one-on-ones, owning performance expectations, or leading organizational change; titles are all individual-contributor (Senior/Staff) apart from a self-founded open-source project. Mobile-platform exposure is limited to a single iOS/tvOS stint a decade ago. Worth a screening call to probe informal leadership and mentoring scope, but the management minimum appears unmet.
strengths: Deep developer-tools and test-infrastructure work (Trial, Fluent-Asserts, CI/CD, GitLab/Docker setup)
15+ years across web, mobile, desktop, embedded, and high-throughput microservices
Proven knowledge-sharing: workshops, courses, conference talks, dojos — signals mentoring aptitude
concerns: No demonstrated people management or direct-report leadership experience
No stated technical-lead or roadmap/organizational-change ownership
Minimal and dated mobile-platform ecosystem experience

key_factors.factor: Developer tools and testing infrastructure depth
